content: Data analysis and many linguistic studies BIBREF11 , BIBREF33 , BIBREF34 , BIBREF35 have repeatedly shown that discourse relations feature continuity and patterns (e.g., a temporal relation is likely to be followed by another temporal relation). Especially, BIBREF11 firstly reported that patterns exist between implicit discourse relations and their neighboring explicit discourse relations.
